unverified.title: Unverified

page.title: Page
page.description: Where the user is, in words.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Write-only; an empty string removes it.

Analysis.title: Analysis
Analysis.description: A cohort or funnel the data allows, with the rule and its reason (060).

AssembleDate.title: AssembleDate
AssembleDate.description:
A new date column from its parts held in separate columns (fix1, B-20): the year, the
month (a number or a month name), the day (the 1st when there is none), and the hour and minute
when given. The part columns stay as they are; a row whose parts make no date (a 31 February,
a missing part) gets an empty date.

AutoEntry.title: AutoEntry
AutoEntry.description: One model the Auto tried: a row of the final leaderboard.

AutoProgress.title: AutoProgress
AutoProgress.description: The Auto's state, read while it runs and kept with the run it saves (its journal).

AutoRequest.title: AutoRequest
AutoRequest.description:
What the Auto may spend and try. `trials`: a fixed number of Optuna trials per tuned
family (the ranking is then reproducible at a fixed seed); None: as many as the time allows.

Backtest.title: Backtest
Backtest.description: One rolling origin: the model saw the first `origin` periods and forecast the next ones.

BrowserLimits.title: BrowserLimits
BrowserLimits.description: What the browser version holds back (102), so that the page can say it.

CategoryRead.title: CategoryRead
CategoryRead.description: A whole-number column read as categories (R-CMP-01).

ChangeType.title: ChangeType
ChangeType.description:
Write the column in another type. Text is read with the given decimal separator, date
formats (tried in order) or true/false words; what cannot be read becomes empty.

ChangedSlice.title: ChangedSlice
ChangedSlice.description: A subgroup where the second run changes the error more than elsewhere.

Choices.title: Choices
Choices.description: Everything the preparation editor can change. The defaults are the automatic rules.

ClassCurves.title: ClassCurves
ClassCurves.description: One class against all the others (multiclass): its ROC, precision-recall and calibration.

Classes.title: Classes
Classes.description: How the numeric target is cut: k - 1 inner limits, k names, intervals (a, b].

CleanFamily.title: CleanFamily
CleanFamily.description: A dataset, its original and every cleaned version of that original (v1 first).

CleanSettings.title: CleanSettings
CleanSettings.description:
Settings > Cleaning. `suggest` (default for now, spec decision 10): suggestions computed
when Clean opens; `off`: on demand; `auto`: a cleaned version made after each new import when
an automatic rule changes a cell.

ColumnChange.title: ColumnChange
ColumnChange.description: A correction of one column. `None` fields are left unchanged.

ColumnChoice.title: ColumnChoice
ColumnChoice.description: What the user set for one column; None = automatic.

ColumnErrors.title: ColumnErrors
ColumnErrors.description: The mean error per category or per quintile of one column.

ColumnStep.title: ColumnStep
ColumnStep.description: A correction of one column (`None` fields are left as detected).

ComputeSettings.title: ComputeSettings
ComputeSettings.description: None = automatic: on when a ready GPU is found. Used by the deep models (023b).

ConformalResult.title: ConformalResult
ConformalResult.description: A number's prediction interval and how well it held on rows it never saw.

row.title: Row
row.description: The file row (as on the Predictions tab).

editable.title: Editable
editable.description: Columns the search may change (default: all but those locked, R-XAI-03).

CounterfactualRequest.title: CounterfactualRequest
CounterfactualRequest.description: What would change one row's prediction (125).

action.title: Action
action.description: The column naming the decision taken (2 to 10 actions).

reward.title: Reward
reward.description: The reward observed after the decision (number or yes/no).

propensity.title: Propensity
propensity.description: Probability of the logged action, in ]0, 1]; estimated when unset.

covariates.title: Covariates
covariates.description: Columns describing each unit; every usable one when unset.

models.title: Models
models.description: Saved ML models (run ids in the app) to evaluate as policies.

learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Also learn a rule from the log (a cross-validated tree on doubly robust scores) and evaluate it: slower, the page's "Advanced > More".

DemandPattern.title: DemandPattern
DemandPattern.description: Syntetos-Boylan classification of a series with zeros.

DerivedSpec.title: DerivedSpec
DerivedSpec.description: What a derived column is computed from (058): a source column and a part of it.

DetectionSettings.title: DetectionSettings
DetectionSettings.description: Bounds keep detection sensible: below half, "mostly numbers" would mean nothing.

DistinctiveWords.title: DistinctiveWords
DistinctiveWords.description: The words of a text column that mark each group (Compare, Segments, Changes).

Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description:
One driver as asked for. `column`: a column of the file, or for a calendar driver one of
`weekday`, `month`, `month_end`. Calendar drivers and flags are always known in advance.

DriverCandidate.title: DriverCandidate
DriverCandidate.description: A column that could be a driver.

DriverEffect.title: DriverEffect
DriverEffect.description: What one driver brings to one model (028 A4).

DriverForecast.title: DriverForecast
DriverForecast.description: One driver model's forecast with given future driver values (scenarios, 039).

DropDuplicates.title: DropDuplicates
DropDuplicates.description: Rows equal on `keys` (every column when None): one is kept.

DropHeaderRows.title: DropHeaderRows
DropHeaderRows.description: Rows whose every value is its column's name: a header repeated inside the file.

ErrorAnalysis.title: ErrorAnalysis
ErrorAnalysis.description: Where a model is wrong: subgroups, error by column, worst predictions, hints.

ErrorPrediction.title: ErrorPrediction
ErrorPrediction.description: One held-out row: its prediction and how wrong it is.

ExpectedColumn.title: ExpectedColumn
ExpectedColumn.description:
A column the model reads: how it was read in training, how much it matters, the
categories it knows and the range it was trained on.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: The column that names each unit's variant (2 to 5).

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: The main metric's column; the first if unset.

control.title: Control
control.description: The control variant; guessed if unset.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: One row per event: the column naming the unit.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Planned share of each variant (equal if unset).

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: Effect per level of this column.

time.title: Time
time.description: Date column for the cumulative difference.

pre.title: Pre
pre.description: The same measure before the experiment (CUPED).

Fairness.title: Fairness
Fairness.description: Metrics side by side for each group of a sensitive column (display only).

FamilyInfo.title: FamilyInfo
FamilyInfo.description: The family of the model (069): chosen by rule from the target, or in the settings.

Fill.title: Fill
Fill.description: Fill empty cells with the value above (down) or below (up), in the file's row order.

FilterStep.title: FilterStep
FilterStep.description: A saved filter; the active one gives its rows to the steps that name it (`filter`).

Fitted.title: Fitted
Fitted.description: What the method found, shown with the run.

FoldSpan.title: FoldSpan
FoldSpan.description: One fold on the time axis: what it trained on, the gap left out, what it was tested on.

ForecastOptions.title: ForecastOptions
ForecastOptions.description: What does not fit in the query string: the drivers (028 A4).

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description:
061, P11: the target a measure is read against, a column (Σ over the same rows) or a
typed value (per period over time, for the whole range otherwise).

GoalOut.title: GoalOut
GoalOut.description: 061, P11: the tile's value against its target, said in words (never by colour alone).

GroupDifference.title: GroupDifference
GroupDifference.description: Mean of b minus mean of a, between two groups of the axis (051).

GroupLayout.title: GroupLayout
GroupLayout.description: How a number and one or two categories were laid out (R-CMP-04, R-CMP-05).

GroupsSetup.title: GroupsSetup
GroupsSetup.description: Every series of the group column, before forecasting them all (039).

Hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
Hierarchy.description: Split by the parent, then the child: the child belongs to one parent (R-SUG-18).

ImageDecisionsIn.title: ImageDecisionsIn
ImageDecisionsIn.description:
108: decisions to merge into the draft, by the image's `rel_path` (exact copies share their
`image_id`); None leaves an image to its rules again.

ImageIndexOut.title: ImageIndexOut
ImageIndexOut.description:
107: the gallery's index, one list per column in the table's row order (the quality
report's `rows` are positions in it). No disk path, no raw hash, no coordinate (R-107-04).

ImageSetOptions.title: ImageSetOptions
ImageSetOptions.description:
What the import reads: a labels file, its label column, the rules undone by code
(`R-VIS-LAY-01` = ignore folder labels, `R-VQ-08`...), quality thresholds (105).

Interval.title: Interval
Interval.description:
A number's prediction interval from the validation errors (split conformal, or CQR: the
quantile band kept on the pipeline, widened by `half_width`) (037, 057).

LabelRows.title: LabelRows
LabelRows.description:
099 (R-PIN-15): a new text column with the label of each pinned row, the rows given by their
number in the file (from 0); the other rows are empty, or `other` when given. The numbers are
those of the current import: after a re-import that reorders the rows, make the step again.

LearningCurve.title: LearningCurve
LearningCurve.description: How the model improved iteration after iteration (iterative models only).

Lowess.title: Lowess
Lowess.description:
LOWESS curve of a scatter (064, R-SM-12): drawn by default when it bends away from the
straight line, i.e. explains clearly more of Y than the line on the same points.

MapValues.title: MapValues
MapValues.description: Old value → new value (None: empty). Only the values listed change (C-05).

MlStep.title: MlStep
MlStep.description: A model trained again on the new rows (not reused: that is predicting, 037).

security.title: Security
security.default: model.joblib is a Python pickle: loading it runs code. Only load a model you exported yourself or got from someone you trust. The Quantilo app never imports model files.

ModelCard.title: ModelCard
ModelCard.description: Everything needed to use the model elsewhere, without a single row of data.

NeutralizeRequest.title: NeutralizeRequest
NeutralizeRequest.description: Remove from a panel run's predictions the part these columns explain (035).

NormalizeSpaces.title: NormalizeSpaces
NormalizeSpaces.description: Trim, and one space for any run of spaces, tabs, line breaks or no-break spaces.

NullOutside.title: NullOutside
NullOutside.description: Numbers below `min` or above `max` become empty.

NullValues.title: NullValues
NullValues.description: These values become empty. `exact`: the stored value as text; `token`: trimmed, any case.

NumericRange.title: NumericRange
NumericRange.description: Where a number's values lie (100, R-FLT-09): shown next to a filter's threshold.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Ordered rows (panel walk-forward or time-based split): what the lags follow.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: A dataset created from a synthetic run.

OriginOut.title: OriginOut
OriginOut.description: Where a dataset comes from: standalone (`source` null) or one table of a source.

PadZeros.title: PadZeros
PadZeros.description:
Digits shorter than `length` get zeros on the left (a postal code that lost its zero);
the column is written as text.

PanelCheck.title: PanelCheck
PanelCheck.description: What the ML page says about the rows: a panel or not, its period and entity.

ParentCandidate.title: ParentCandidate
ParentCandidate.description: A categorical column that could sit above the group in a hierarchy (039).

Parser.title: Parser
Parser.description:
How to read a stored value in its analysis type, applied at query time.

- raw: the stored value as is
- number: text with a given decimal separator (thousands separators, %, currency stripped)
- date: text with a strptime format
- boolean: text mapped with true/false vocabularies (empty lists: cast the value)
- year: integer year → date (January 1st)
- text: the value as text, null tokens removed
- time: a time of day (TIME, or text with a strptime `format`) → hours since midnight (092)
- derived: a value computed from another column (`derived`, 058): the length of a text...

A date read with two formats (092, R-TYP-06) lists them in `formats`, the first one in `format`.

PeriodSummary.title: PeriodSummary
PeriodSummary.description: How regular the model is from one period to the next.

smooth_reason.title: Smooth Reason
smooth_reason.default: On: continuous numbers stay off the real values, so far fewer rows copy a real one.

PolicyOffer.title: PolicyOffer
PolicyOffer.description: Whether "who should get which variant" can be computed for an analysis (R-PL1).

covariates.title: Covariates
covariates.description: Columns describing the units before the test; every usable one if unset.

qini.title: Qini
qini.description: Add the Qini curves (the page's "Advanced > More", asked when opened).

keep.title: Keep
keep.description: Columns kept next to the predictions.

PredictionDistribution.title: PredictionDistribution
PredictionDistribution.description: The predictions on this data against those on the validation rows.

PredictionSummary.title: PredictionSummary
PredictionSummary.description: A prediction made with a run, as the run lists it.

PreparationPreview.title: PreparationPreview
PreparationPreview.description: The matrix the model really receives: the first training rows once prepared.

QQ.title: QQ
QQ.description: Sample quantiles against the standard normal's, with the line through Q1 and Q3.

QualityFindingOut.title: QualityFindingOut
QualityFindingOut.description: A quality rule that fired (R-VQ, 105), with its thresholds and the rows concerned.

ReasonOut.title: ReasonOut
ReasonOut.description: A rule code and its sentence: why the app reads something this way.

RecipeChanges.title: RecipeChanges
RecipeChanges.description: What changed (031), at the top of a run's report.

RecipeColumn.title: RecipeColumn
RecipeColumn.description:
A column of the dataset the recipe was made on: its name and detected type (what a new
file is matched on), and for a category read by a step, its values (to flag new ones).

RecipeDraft.title: RecipeDraft
RecipeDraft.description: Everything a dataset keeps, as the steps of a recipe to tick.

RemoveInvisible.title: RemoveInvisible
RemoveInvisible.description: Remove zero-width characters, byte-order marks, soft hyphens and control characters.

RowCondition.title: RowCondition
RowCondition.description:
On the stored value (decision 5 of the spec): numbers compare as numbers, the rest as
text.

RowStructure.title: RowStructure
RowStructure.description: What the rows are: independent, one series in time, or a panel (entities × periods).

RowValue.title: RowValue
RowValue.description: One value of a row, placed on its column (the row's card).

RuleNoteOut.title: RuleNoteOut
RuleNoteOut.description: A reading rule that fired: the sentence shown, why it exists, how many files.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: A trained model as the page shows it (stored as JSON next to the fitted pipeline).

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: Everything not given takes the plan's automatic choice.

sd.title: Sd
sd.description: Standard deviation of a mean metric.

relative.title: Relative
relative.description: The effect is a lift (0.05 = +5 %), else absolute.

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: Units of each variant per control unit.

daily.title: Daily
daily.description: Units entering the test per day.

ScenarioChange.title: ScenarioChange
ScenarioChange.description:
One change of a what-if scenario (039 story 6): a known-in-advance driver moved by
`amount` % (`how="percent"`, -10 = ten percent lower) or set to `amount` (`how="value"`),
on the forecast periods from `start` to `end` (period labels such as "2025-12"; None = from
the first, or to the last, forecast period).

ScenarioOptions.title: ScenarioOptions
ScenarioOptions.description: The drivers and what changes in their future values (039 story 6).

SearchParam.title: SearchParam
SearchParam.description: One setting of the search space, as the user may change it.

SegmentDendrogram.title: SegmentDendrogram
SegmentDendrogram.description: Ward's tree, its last merges only (scipy's dendrogram coordinates).

SegmentPlan.title: SegmentPlan
SegmentPlan.description: What a segmentation with these choices would use, before running it.

SegmentRequest.title: SegmentRequest
SegmentRequest.description: Everything not given follows the app's rules.

SegmentScore.title: SegmentScore
SegmentScore.description:
How well k groups separate (higher silhouette and Calinski–Harabasz, lower Davies–Bouldin,
inertia and BIC are better).

SegmentStability.title: SegmentStability
SegmentStability.description:
Mean adjusted Rand index between the segmentation and the same method refitted on 10
subsamples of 80 % of the rows.

SequenceRequest.title: SequenceRequest
SequenceRequest.description: TimeGAN: every field not given takes the plan's choice.

SeriesConfig.title: SeriesConfig
SeriesConfig.description: A time series analysis as the Time series page keeps it (Save analysis).

SeriesDrivers.title: SeriesDrivers
SeriesDrivers.description: The columns that could explain the series (028 A4), most correlated first.

SeriesRegimes.title: SeriesRegimes
SeriesRegimes.description: Regimes of the series (062), computed on demand only (Advanced).

SeriesSetup.title: SeriesSetup
SeriesSetup.description: The configuration actually used: every field chosen or defaulted.

SeriesSmoothing.title: SeriesSmoothing
SeriesSmoothing.description:
Smoothed curves of the analysed series (064), the methods suggested by the data and the
ones that do not apply to this period.

ShapeAt.title: ShapeAt
ShapeAt.description: ξ̂ at another threshold, to see whether it is stable.

Slice.title: Slice
Slice.description: A subgroup where the model is notably worse than on average.

SourceOptions.title: SourceOptions
SourceOptions.description: How to read a source. `None` fields mean "detect" or "everything".

StepLink.title: StepLink
StepLink.description: A page of the app the step filled (the library leaves it empty).

StructureRule.title: StructureRule
StructureRule.description: Whether the Correlations page proposes the Structure section (R-STR-1), and why.

TableArea.title: TableArea
TableArea.description: Where a detected table sits in its sheet (1-based, inclusive), to draw it on the original.

TableChoice.title: TableChoice
TableChoice.description: One table the source gives (080b: a table of a sheet; 085: a linked table of a document).

TableLink.title: TableLink
TableLink.description: `parent.parent_key` = `child.child_key` between two tables of a document (R-KEY-03).

TailRule.title: TailRule
TailRule.description: Whether the Tail tab is shown, and why (R-TAIL-1).

TargetDistribution.title: TargetDistribution
TargetDistribution.description:
What the browser needs to cut the target: exact quantiles, a fine histogram, a sorted
sample (natural breaks) and, for few distinct values, each value with its count.

TargetFolds.title: TargetFolds
TargetFolds.description: How the target encoding is cross-fitted, and why (R-CAT-08).

TermNote.title: TermNote
TermNote.description: What a term did, or why it could not (shown in Advanced › Terms).

TextSummary.title: TextSummary
TextSummary.description: Language and length of a text column (050), on at most 5,000 distinct texts.

TextVocabulary.title: TextVocabulary
TextVocabulary.description:
How the model reads a free-text column (052): the cut, the terms it knows (words or
pieces of words, no row), and how much of its training texts the vocabulary missed.

TextWords.title: TextWords
TextWords.description: The terms of one free-text column that move the predictions most (052).

TimeView.title: TimeView
TimeView.description: How a date and a number was turned into a series (each setting chosen or defaulted).

TopicRule.title: TopicRule
TopicRule.description: A topic as the Topic rule reads it (059, R-TOP-05): its words and their weights.

Training.title: Training
Training.description: The very advanced training settings of the deep generators (CTGAN, TVAE, TimeGAN).

UnusualCurve.title: UnusualCurve
UnusualCurve.description: Scores sorted from the most unusual row down: every listed rank, then a sampled tail.

Validation.title: Validation
Validation.description: How the model is judged, and on how many rows it is trained.

VersionSettings.title: VersionSettings
VersionSettings.description:
Keep the previous version's Parquet copy at a reimport (031), for the row by row
comparison: always, under the size limit (2 GB, 200 MB in the browser build) or never.

WordsAnswer.title: WordsAnswer
WordsAnswer.description: 059: the words that rise in each version of a text column, when both are at hand.

quantilo__ingestion__preview__Detection.title: Detection
quantilo__ingestion__preview__Detection.description: What the first bytes say about the file (082): its kind, its format, the rule and why.
